items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: we played behind Mae West. I remember I did the obligato background to 'My Old Flame.' With Mae West in the picture.

ctx.x: Oh, oneof our 7- one of our first actresses I remember was Sylvia Sidney. And the -- in fact we worked so many of them that I can't keep track of the stars. Mae West and oh, all of them.

The reason I'm asking specifically is because I think it would be very interesting to see an old film made during that era right now -- maybe on television -- and hear the trombone and realize that that is Lawrence Brown playing on that film score, which most people don't know. That's why I was wondering if you could remember any of the films --
